CVE-2021-44228.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints (Log4Shell).

CVE-2014-0160.description: The TLS heartbeat extension in OpenSSL allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory (Heartbleed).

CVE-2020-1472.description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Netlogon (Zerologon) allows establishing a vulnerable secure channel to a domain controller.
